questions: How many CuMnAs/Al bars did you measure, on how many chips and in how many cooldowns, and how many showed the remanent reversal of Fig. 3d?
Why were the others set aside?
Which ranges did you measure beyond the ones shown: η versus temperature, η versus small applied field, larger preparation fields along [100], and repeated loops?
What does the second-best device or dataset look like, for example the Fig. 3d loop after a new cooldown?
What is your magnet's residual field at nominal H = 0 after the ±1 T and ±4 T excursions, how was zero calibrated, and is the crystal [100] axis along the same coil for both bars?
At what temperature was the preparation field applied, and does the prepared η survive warming above 350 mK and recooling in a nulled field?
Could you read out the Néel state on the superconducting heterostructure itself, since Fig. 4 uses a separate wafer at 5 K?
After preparation along [010], η stays predominantly of one sign (Fig. 3e): what sets that sign, and does it match the 7% after zero-field cooling?
